title: memohopper memory
summary: Connects the memohopper memory service and adds rules to use it as primary memory, with tasks.
benefit: Decisions and facts carry over between sessions and projects.
solves: Decisions and facts that vanish when a session ends or you move to another project.
use_cases: "remember this", "save this" or "store this": the fact goes to memohopper, not to a local file.
Each folder you work in maps to a workspace, so each project's knowledge stays apart.
Session start: Claude reads the briefing and the open tasks of that workspace and names the relevant ones.
Tasks are your to-do list there: what you ask for is added, Claude's own ideas wait as proposals.
Needs a memohopper account and an API key; stored text and recalls go over the network.
details: Connects the memohopper memory service so Claude stores and recalls memories, tasks and a workspace-based knowledge graph there, with file memory kept only as an index. It is for people with a memohopper account who want memory that travels between projects. It adds rules loaded every session, a user-scope HTTP MCP server (mcp.memohopper.com) and a workspace table you fill in; stored text and recalls go over the network with your API key.

values.ask: Your memohopper workspaces as table rows: | folder | workspace |

user_steps: Create a memohopper account and an API key.

Set the user environment variable MEMOHOPPER_API_KEY to that key, then restart Claude Code. If the server reports a missing key, put the key in the server's headers yourself; ${VAR} expansion for user-scope MCP entries is not verified in the docs.
risk: Claude sends what it stores and recalls to the memohopper service over the network (mcp.memohopper.com); the rules are loaded every session.
